Vendored sources of LeanTex/Core/GlyphListData.lean (scripts/gen-glyphlist-data.lean).

glyphlist.txt
  The Adobe Glyph List, table version 2.0 (September 20, 2002), from
  https://github.com/adobe-type-tools/agl-aglfn as TeX Live 2026 (20260301)
  ships it: texmf-dist/fonts/map/glyphlist/glyphlist.txt. Taken whole.
  Licence: Apache License 2.0 (its header; LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt).

8a.enc
  Adobe StandardEncoding as an afm2tfm/dvips encoding file, version 1.1
  (12jun05), from TeX Live 2026 (20260301): texmf-dist/fonts/enc/dvips/base/8a.enc.
  Taken whole. Its header states the licence: public domain.

cp1252.py, mac_roman.py
  Python 3.14.8's codecs for Windows code page 1252 and Mac OS Roman,
  generated by Python's gencodec.py from Unicode's mapping files
  (MAPPINGS/VENDORS/MICSFT/WINDOWS/CP1252.TXT, MAPPINGS/VENDORS/APPLE/ROMAN.TXT):
  Lib/encodings/cp1252.py and Lib/encodings/mac_roman.py. Taken whole; the
  generator reads only their decoding tables.
  Licence: Python Software Foundation License (LICENSE-PYTHON.txt, Python's own LICENSE.txt).

cff_parser.js, encodings.js
  pdf.js (https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js) at commit
  519c1ba8ea02023e005dfc68c9442db1fed3fc01: src/core/cff_parser.js and
  src/core/encodings.js. Taken whole; the generator reads only the CFF
  standard strings (Adobe Technical Note #5176, Appendix A) from the first,
  and the glyph names of WinAnsiEncoding, MacRomanEncoding,
  StandardEncoding and the CFF Expert encoding (ISO 32000-2 Annex D; Technical
  Note #5176, Appendix C) from the second. Its StandardEncoding is checked
  against 8a.enc at generation.
  Licence: Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE-PDFJS.txt, pdf.js's own LICENSE).

Left out: the AGL for New Fonts (aglfn.txt) and the ITC Zapf Dingbats list
(zapfdingbats.txt), which no reading here needs; the PDF's Symbol and
ZapfDingbats built-in encodings, which belong to unembedded fonts the
importer names as a loss; the rest of pdf.js, whose code no reading here
runs.
